name: Bionic Banker Route Map
purpose: Visitor-facing route index for Bionic Banker pages, systems, field notes, learning notes, and visible signal surfaces.
principles: Answer with visible website routes first.
Point claims toward pages, field notes, and public artifacts.
Keep unpublished notes, machine details, credentials, client data, and employer data out of the visitor layer.
Do not send applications, messages, emails, or third-party actions from this site index.
